name: bullets
title: Bullets
description: A list in running text, with its markers hung in a column of their own.
use: Points in an article, what a plan includes, steps written as prose. A marker is a dot, a check with bullets-check, or the item's number with bullets-numbered. Mark what is not included with bullets-off and say so in words.

instead.when: The rows are things with media, a title and something at the end
The reader ticks the items off
The items are terms and their values
It is a sequence with one step current

classes.name: bullets
classes.description: The list: items 8px apart, each with a small dot in a 16px column 10px from the text. It takes the ink of the text it stands in, so it reads on a card and on an ink surface alike

classes.name: bullets-check
classes.description: A check in the ink of the text in place of the dot, for what is included

classes.name: bullets-numbered
classes.description: Each item's number in tabular figures, set to the end of the marker column; use it on an ol

classes.name: bullets-item
classes.description: One item; its marker stands on its first line and its text starts on one edge with the others

classes.name: bullets-off
classes.description: An item that is not included: a short dash in place of its marker and quieter words
